fact: On 14 October 2024 the President of the Senate told the IPU Assembly that Burundi's parliament had voted only a cybercrime law and that regulation and control of AI is inevitable and needed urgently, with no AI rule yet in force.
title: Communication du Très Honorable Emmanuel Sinzohagera, Président du Sénat de la République du Burundi à l'occasion de la 149è Assemblée de l'Union Interparlementaire (UIP)
publisher: Sénat de la République du Burundi
